title: Confirmatory Preregistration v4 FIX4 -- calibration-bias diagnostic history & action selection

claim_scope.confirmatory_question: whether, when the hidden deployment calibration state is stable across repeated tasks, the history from ONE fixed full-task-level diagnostic trial lets a capacity-matched history-conditioned selector pick a better discrete action parameter on UNSEEN nominal deployment conditions and raise subsequent task success
claim_scope.generalization_claim: unseen NOMINAL deployment conditions, actual hidden-state support inside training support
claim_scope.positive_control_note: the 3-point candidate bank is a constructed positive-control skill library frozen by the independent exploration phase, to validate the history-conditioned action-selection mechanism; NOT a claim over arbitrary continuous action spaces, arbitrary tasks, or long-horizon autonomous adaptation
claim_scope.primary_claim: diagnostic history improves subsequent action-selection success
claim_scope.multitask_heads_auxiliary: The task-outcome-error and elapsed-time regression heads are auxiliary multitask training signals. Candidate selection and the primary endpoint use predicted/observed success only. This experiment neither identifies nor claims that multidimensional error/time prediction outperforms a success-only predictor.

seed_derivation: seed(label) = int(sha256(f'{SEED_ROOT}|{label}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:16], 16) % (2**63 - 1); SEED_ROOT = 'confirmatory-v4|<power_cert_commit>'; UTF-8 bytes; first 16 hex chars; base 16; modulus 2**63-1

model.name: B2_deepsets
model.encoder: deepsets (permutation-invariant: shared phi MLP per probe, mean+sum pool, rho)
model.batching: FULL-BATCH gradient descent (one Adam step per epoch over the entire train set)
model.feature_normalization: standardize static (train mu/sd), standardize probe vectors (train pooled mu/sd), z-normalize the two continuous targets (train mu/sd); success target NOT normalized; eps 1e-8
model.initialization: default PyTorch init under torch.manual_seed(seed) and np.random.seed(seed)
model.determinism: seeds set per model_seed; CPU full-batch -> deterministic rerun (verified by test)
model.validation_metric: the multitask training loss evaluated on the validation fold
model.early_stopping: patience=25 epochs, improvement threshold 1e-5 on val loss
model.checkpoint_selection: restore the state_dict at minimum validation loss (best_state)
model.prediction_tie_break: strict-greater argmax scanning the bank in fixed order (-0.04, 0.0, +0.04); on an exact tie the earliest bank index is kept
model.training_failure_handling: a model-fit failure is an analysis-stage event governed by MODEL_FIT (namespace model_fit_failure_count); it is NOT a runtime trial and does NOT consume the 300-trial runtime-invalid budget
model_validity_conditions: train and validation loss both finite
inference from the reloaded checkpoint is finite

model_fit.required: 5/5 fixed seeds valid for BOTH K0 and K1 (10 checkpoints); all hashes frozen
model_fit.reaching_max_epochs_is_not_failure: hitting max_epochs without early-stop is VALID if the validity conditions hold
model_fit.retry: initial attempt + at most 1 deterministic retry, ONLY for an infrastructural exception / abnormal process exit / reproducible I/O failure
retry_constraints: do NOT change initialization or training budget
model_fit.on_invalid: do NOT generate the test manifest; do NOT unseal test
model_fit.namespace: model_fit_failure_count  (SEPARATE from runtime_trial_invalid_count; NOT subject to the >15 runtime rule)

primary_success.definition: y.success as produced by the frozen runtime open_drawer success condition

best_single.data: train + validation candidate trials ONLY (test never participates)
rule: 1. maximize observed mean binary success over train+val candidate trials
3. tie -> first in the frozen candidate-bank numeric order {-0.04, 0.00, +0.04}
best_single.selection_algorithm: equal denominators (57/offset) -> integer observed_success_count per offset; max count; tie -> min|offset|; tie -> earliest in bank order

offset_domain_strict.rule: reject bool / non-numeric (incl. numeric strings) / non-finite; accept only within isclose(rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-12) of a bank offset; return the exact frozen float; round(.,3) NEVER decides legality

checks: y.success present and strict Python bool

best_single.simulation_only_reference: learned_selector_power.best_single_legal (reconstructs label from secret; NOT production; retained as the bridge baseline only)
best_single.invariance_proof: best_single_tiebreak_invariance_v1.json (4500 replicates: 0 step-1 ties, 0 old/new mismatches -> the removed secret tie-break was dead code; no power recert)

primary.comparator: Delta_primary = seed-averaged B2_K1 selected success - train/val-only best-single success
primary.aggregation: per test block: average over the 2 test nominals, then average over the 5 model seeds (B2); best-single averaged over the 2 nominals in the same block
primary.point_estimate: mean over test blocks of gain_b

plus_gate.precondition: all 5 model seeds exist and are technically valid (MODEL_FIT); a missing/invalid seed makes the experiment INVALID and is NOT treated as a gain<0 seed nor dropped from the denominator
plus_gate.role: PRIMARY necessary quality gate (GO requires it)

secondary.H2_history: Delta_history = B2_K1 - capacity-matched B1_K0 (same DeepSets, empty history); report point estimate + 95% block bootstrap CI (does NOT replace primary)
secondary.k0_k1_capacity: K0 and K1 are the SAME DeepSets (same d_hid/d_emb/budget/seeds); the ONLY difference is empty history (K0) vs one frozen probe-history entry (K1)
secondary.oracle: OracleZ / state-aware oracle reads the secret actual bias; AUDIT UPPER BOUND ONLY -- never in model input, training, best-single, or primary selection

bootstrap.resample_unit: test nuisance block (keeps both test nominals, all 5 seeds, block candidate correspondence)

collision_rule.monitored_scope: robot non-finger links (arm/hand) vs cabinet; intended finger-handle contact EXCLUDED
collision_rule.primary: intention-to-analyze: primary success includes ALL schema-valid task trials regardless of unintended-contact force (no trial dropped for collision)
collision_rule.collision_confounded_definition: a schema-valid trial with max_unintended_contact_force_N > 0.0 N on monitored (non-finger) links
collision_rule.sensitivity: re-run the primary contrast excluding pre-registered collision-confounded trials; report whether the CI_lower>=0.15 verdict is unchanged

technical_invalid.scope: RUNTIME full-task trials ONLY (namespace runtime_trial_invalid_count); model-fit failures are governed separately by MODEL_FIT and do NOT count here
invalid_conditions: incomplete schema (missing required field, incl. any probe allowlist field)
invalid initial state / full_reset not verified
technical_invalid.policy: fail-fast then resume from the frozen manifest at the failed planned trial
technical_invalid.experiment_invalid_if: >15 runtime technical-invalid trials, OR any unresolved manifest/leakage/integrity breach

seal_unseal: Step 0 PRE-RUN FREEZE: freeze+hash the fix1 v4 commit, confirmatory config, all exact seeds, the manifest-generation algorithm, schema, generator commit (future, post-GO), train/val/test planned structure, and the test split identities + nominal sets. No test outcomes exist yet.
Step 1 GENERATE TRAIN/VAL MANIFEST deterministically from the frozen config+seeds; save its hash; no resample.
Step 2 RUN TRAIN/VAL TRIALS (only train/validation runtime data generated).
Step 3 FREEZE TRAIN/VAL DATA: integrity + leakage validation, dataset hashes, train/val lock file.
Step 4 SELECT BEST-SINGLE and TRAIN MODELS on train/validation ONLY (5 fixed seeds for K0 and K1; all 10 must be valid); save state_dict hashes.

Step 5 FREEZE ANALYSIS (before ANY test trial): 5 K0 hashes, 5 K1 hashes, best-single artifact/hash, feature-extraction code hash, final-analysis code hash, bootstrap seed, collision sensitivity rule, exclusion/invalidation rules -> write model_analysis_freeze.json.

Step 6 GENERATE TEST MANIFEST once, deterministically, from the frozen test seeds + algorithm + generator commit + config (only after Step 5 passes); save the test manifest hash. No reselecting seeds, no generate-many-and-pick, no changing test geometry/block count/nominal/order/residual rules.
Step 7 RUN TEST TRIALS per the test manifest.
Step 8 ONE-SHOT FINAL ANALYSIS with the frozen models and analysis code.

access_control.early_test_access_condition: generating or reading any test outcome before Step 5 completes

post_unseal_forbidden: generate multiple test manifests and pick

planned_identity_format.float_format: signed fixed-point, exactly 3 decimals, unit metre; zero=+0.000; negative zero forbidden
planned_identity_format.storage_sort: split(train=0,validation=1,test=2) -> block asc -> nominal asc -> role(probe=0,candidate=1) -> offset asc
planned_identity_format.canonical_json: sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, UTF-8, no trailing newline

domain_validation.numeric_match: math.isclose(rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-12) then canonicalize to the exact frozen value; finite only; NaN/Inf rejected; formatting rounding cannot legalize (0.0346 rejected)
domain_validation.attempt_index: non-bool int in {0,1}; planned_episode_id must match ^v4ep-[0-9a-f]{24}$

deep_manifest_validator.authoritative_note: authoritative validator description = deep_manifest_validator (exactly one active checks list)
deep_manifest_validator.rejects_bogus: a 228-duplicate / all-train / PID!=identity / non-canonical-order manifest is INVALID (no full hash)
deep_manifest_validator.storage_order_vs_execution_order: STORAGE order = split rank -> block_index asc -> nominal numeric asc -> role(probe<candidate) -> offset asc (how the blocks/sessions/trials LISTS are serialized). EXECUTION order = seed-derived resolve_block_order -> resolve_session_order -> probe first -> resolve_candidate_order, carried by execution_order_index. A storage list position does NOT define execution order; execution_order_index does.

per session probe(-0.04) + 3 candidates(bank); probe executes before candidates

compatibility_gate.note: PCG64 raw state + Generator.normal + float conversion must pass the KAT; recording the NumPy version alone is NOT sufficient to release; on KAT failure no phase manifest/hash may be produced. Future generator preflight #1 = require_known_answer_compatibility(); generators must never call the private unchecked core.

setup_order: set OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS + threads + deterministic_algorithms BEFORE any torch op
determinism_env.deterministic_unsupported: a required deterministic op raising RuntimeError -> model_fit_failure_count; same-seed infra retry at most once; still failing -> EXPERIMENT_INVALID_MODEL_FIT
determinism_env.no_gpu_switch: switching to GPU voids the protocol; may not silently disable determinism

order_resolution.rule: SHA256-derived integer key + stable lexicographic sort + canonical-index tie-break; NO random/RNG/hash()/dict-iteration order
order_resolution.execution_order: phase split order -> resolve_block_order -> resolve_session_order -> probe first -> resolve_candidate_order; validator checks execution_order_index == plan index

go_fail_invalid.EXPERIMENT_INVALID: pre-registered integrity/leakage/manifest/runtime-technical conditions, OR EXPERIMENT_INVALID_MODEL_FIT, OR EXPERIMENT_INVALID_EARLY_TEST_ACCESS
